Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive __epoxy__ binder; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an __electronic component surface or a microelectronic component surface__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the __electronic component surface or microelectronic component surface__.
